newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Cyberporn guide a bestseller in Taiwan.
newsitem.headline: Cyberporn guide a bestseller in Taiwan.

text.p: Breastman Page. Busty Babes. Cyber Vixens.
Those are some of the more than 500 pornographic websites featured in a hot-selling new guidebook called "Internet Red Light District" published recently in Taiwan.
Booksellers at Taipei's teeming Kuanghua hackers' bazaar said the cyberporn primer is a first for the island.
They said the book, featuring far more pictures than words, had become a bestseller since hitting cyberspace in August.
"This book is the first of its kind in Taiwan so it obviously attracts a lot of attention. It's very good for business," said one vendor who identified himself only as Tsai.
"We've had to make new orders constantly because of high demand," Tsai said.
The book's publisher, Le Libre International Ltd of Taiwan, said it has printed about 9,000 copies but did not have figures on how many had been sold to consumers.
Tsai said he alone has sold more than 300 copies of the T$250 (US$9) guide.
The Chinese-language directory ranks the top Net-porn locations by the number of log-ins or "hits" and carries more than 200 colour pictures from erotic websites.
